name: Sushil Kumar Jiwarajka
bio: Five decades of building businesses, powering rural India, championing industry, and giving back to society.
pull_quote: A builder of enterprises, a champion of rural India, a diplomat, a philanthropist — and an accomplished singer at heart.
nameplate_title: Industrialist · Social Entrepreneur · Honorary Consul General of Greece
background:
- Full name: Sushil Kumar Jiwarajka. Known as a senior Mumbai-based industrialist, social entrepreneur, philanthropist, motivational speaker and accomplished singer of Indian film music.
- Founder and Chairman of the Artheon and Essjay group of companies, with interests spanning telecom, information technology, renewable energy, industrial batteries, e-commerce, real estate, education and investment banking. Group turnover approximately USD 250 million.
- Chairman and Managing Director of Essjay Ericsson Pvt Ltd, a joint venture with LM Ericsson of Sweden, providing managed services, network roll-out, operations and maintenance to mobile operators and renewable energy firms in India.
- Co-founder and Chairman of OMC Power Pvt Ltd (also known as Omnigrid Micropower Company), established in 2011. OMC finances, builds and operates village-level solar power plants with mini-grid distribution, serving telecom anchor customers and rural communities (schools, clinics, homes). Named a World Economic Forum Global Technology Pioneer (~2014) and recipient of an Economic Times Telecom Award (~2015).
- Belongs to the Jiwarajka family, an entrepreneurial business family with deep roots in Indian electronics and telecom. His father was among the largest importers of electronic components in India, sourcing from Germany, Japan and elsewhere. The family's listed flagship is Salora International Limited (origins in the late 1960s, public company since 1993). He is managing trustee of the Dwarkadas Jiwarajka Memorial Trust, Mumbai.
- Education: Bachelor of Commerce, University of Mumbai. Business education strongly shaped by the family trade — early immersion in international sourcing, negotiation, finance and joint ventures.
- Joint ventures over the career: LM Ericsson (Sweden), Matsushita (Japan), Hewlett-Packard, and NorthStar Battery Company (USA) for valve regulated lead acid batteries. Artheon Electronics manufactures sealed maintenance-free batteries from Nashik and has executed rooftop solar EPC projects across India.
- Industry statesmanship: Past Chairman, Western Regional Council, FICCI (over a decade from ~2000); championed airport modernisation, nutraceuticals, technical textiles, brand protection, industrial design clusters, wine manufacturing in Nashik, entertainment sector support. Past Chairman, Energy Storage Committee, FICCI. Past President, International Chamber of Commerce India; Past President, All India Organisation of Employers; Past Chairman, Indo-Arab Chamber of Commerce and Industry; Past President, Infrastructure and Logistics Federation of India (2013–2019); National Vice President, Air Passengers Association of India; sub-committee on off-grid solutions, Global Task Force, International Solar Alliance.
- Chairman, Infrastructure Corporation of Africa (digital infrastructure development on the continent). Member, Frontier 100 (business leaders from Africa, South Asia, USA and Europe focused on frontier market investment).
- Charter member, The Indus Entrepreneurs, Mumbai; management council member, World Trade Centre, Mumbai; member, American Business Club.
- Public service: Chairman, Maharashtra State Security Council; Founder, Medical Tourism Council of Maharashtra; member of various central and state government committees; independent director on several company boards.
- Honorary Consul General of Greece for Western India (consulate in Mumbai): promotes trade, investment, tourism and cultural ties between India and Greece; represents Greek interests in Western India.
- Led the business delegation accompanying a landmark Indian presidential visit to Sweden and Belarus in 2015. Active in India–Africa economic diplomacy.
- Philanthropy — core causes: sanitation, rural women's health, girl-child education. Has funded construction of toilets in rural Maharashtra (part of a goal of thousands of toilets across rural India). Has taken personal responsibility for the upbringing, education and welfare of dozens of orphaned girls.
- Chairs Advisory Board, Global Vikas Trust (associated with the Global Parli rural transformation project working to rejuvenate agriculture and rural economics in Maharashtra and Madhya Pradesh). Served as Chairperson of the Advisory Board for Manthan 2025 summit (global dialogue on nation building, rural prosperity and climate resilience).
- Philanthropic associations: Roti Bank (surplus food collection and distribution, Mumbai); empowHER India (women's empowerment and rural sanitation); International Development Enterprises India (low-cost innovations for small and marginal farmers); Aditya Jyot Foundation for Twinkling Little Eyes (eye care for underprivileged communities). Also associated with a bamboo cultivation and fibreboard project in Madhya Pradesh.
- Mentor and angel investor: has nurtured young entrepreneurs and early-stage companies, many in high technology and clean energy.
- Personal passions: Indian film music (accomplished singer), motivational speaking, community and cultural organisations, Rotary connections.
- Leadership philosophy: stay globally aware; read international forces and technological disruption; practise open communication (learnt from a father who sought his views from a young age); use new technologies to grow businesses and to make giving back easier.
reference_material:
OMC POWER (OMNIGRID MICROPOWER COMPANY):
- Co-founded in 2011 with the mission to finance, build and operate solar power plants at the village level with mini-grid distribution.
- Model: telecom towers serve as anchor customers, generating commercial revenue that cross-subsidises clean power to surrounding schools, clinics, small businesses and homes.
- Grew into one of India's largest solar mini-grid companies, described in some profiles as among the largest in the world.
- Patented technology enabling reliable, clean energy at rural telecom sites and communities.
- Awards: World Economic Forum Global Technology Pioneer (~2014); Economic Times Telecom Award (~2015).
- Rich territory: the founding idea, finding the right partners, the first village that got light, the moment the model proved itself, the challenges of rural infrastructure.

ESSJAY ERICSSON PRIVATE LIMITED:
- Joint venture with LM Ericsson of Sweden, with Sushil Jiwarajka as Chairman and Managing Director.
- Services: managed services, outsourcing of network roll-out, operations and maintenance for mobile operators and renewable energy companies.
- The relationship with Ericsson is a flagship example of his approach to joint ventures: bringing global technology and standards into India through long-term partnerships.
- Other JVs: Matsushita (Japan), Hewlett-Packard, NorthStar Battery Company (USA) for valve regulated lead acid batteries.

ARTHEON ELECTRONICS & THE GROUP:
- Artheon Electronics: manufactures and distributes sealed maintenance-free batteries from Nashik; has executed rooftop solar EPC projects across India.
- Working on next-generation lithium-ion battery technology.
- The group sits at the intersection of telecom infrastructure, energy storage and clean energy.

FICCI WESTERN REGIONAL COUNCIL:
- Served as Chairman for over a decade from around 2000 — a remarkable tenure of sustained industry leadership in Western India.
- Initiatives championed: airport modernisation, nutraceuticals, technical textiles, brand protection, industrial design clusters, wine manufacturing in Nashik, entertainment sector.
- Rich territory: the state of Indian industry at the turn of the century, the causes he chose to champion and why, the debates inside the chambers, what it means to speak for an entire region's business community.

HONORARY CONSUL GENERAL OF GREECE FOR WESTERN INDIA:
- Diplomatic role based in Mumbai: promotes trade, investment, tourism and cultural ties between India and Greece.
- Has highlighted Greece as a destination for Indian travellers and investors, pointing to its history, climate and hospitality.
- Represents Greek interests in Western India.
- Rich territory: how the appointment came about, memorable moments building the India–Greece bridge, his vision for the relationship.

2015 PRESIDENTIAL DELEGATION TO SWEDEN AND BELARUS:
- Led the business delegation accompanying the Indian Prime Minister and senior ministers on a landmark visit to Sweden and Belarus.
- Rich territory: the preparation, the conversations with Swedish business leaders, the connection to his Ericsson relationship, what the visit achieved.

GLOBAL VIKAS TRUST AND MANTHAN 2025:
- Chairs the Advisory Board of the Global Vikas Trust, associated with the Global Parli rural transformation project.
- Independent assessment points to substantial multiplication of farmer incomes across thousands of villages in Maharashtra and Madhya Pradesh.
- Chairperson of the Advisory Board for Manthan 2025, a summit on nation building, rural prosperity and climate resilience.
- Rich territory: what drove him to rural development, the moment he saw the model working, what Manthan 2025 was trying to achieve.

PHILANTHROPY — SANITATION AND GIRL-CHILD EDUCATION:
- Funded construction of toilets in rural Maharashtra as part of a goal of thousands of toilets across rural India.
- Personally taken responsibility for the upbringing, education and welfare of dozens of orphaned girls.
- Associations with Roti Bank, empowHER India, IDEA India, Aditya Jyot Foundation for Twinkling Little Eyes.
- Rich territory: the moment he decided to take personal responsibility for the girls, the connection between sanitation and dignity, the faces and stories behind the numbers.

FAMILY HERITAGE AND THE JIWARAJKA NAME:
- Father: one of the largest importers of electronic components in India, sourcing from Germany and Japan; an early global traveller among Indian entrepreneurs.
- The father's culture of seeking his son's views from a young age — the origin of his belief in open communication.
- Salora International Limited: the family's listed flagship, origins in the late 1960s, IPO in 1993.
- Dwarkadas Jiwarajka Memorial Trust: carries the family name in Mumbai's philanthropic landscape.
- Rich territory: growing up in a household where the world came to the dinner table, the lessons from the father, the weight of carrying a family name.

MUSIC AND PERSONAL LIFE:
- Accomplished singer of Indian film music; this is not a hobby but a genuine artistic passion and a part of his public identity.
- Associated with several social and cultural organisations; connected to Rotary.
- Known as a motivational speaker who draws on a long career to encourage entrepreneurship, resilience and social responsibility.
- Rich territory: the songs that mean the most to him, whether music has ever influenced a business decision or a hard moment, what he would say to a young entrepreneur starting out today.
